Link in Bio Maker

Build a personal link-in-bio page and download it as a standalone HTML file.

Live preview

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your name, tagline and bio.
  2. Add links with labels and URLs.
  3. Pick a theme and see the live preview.
  4. Click Download HTML to get your page.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it work?

Add your name, bio and links one by one, pick a theme, then click Download HTML — you get a single self-contained file you can host anywhere.

Is the download standalone?

Yes — the download is one HTML file with inline styles; no external dependencies.

Where can I host it?

Upload it to any static host (GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel) or use it as your bio link directly.

Do links open in a new tab?

Links open in a new tab by default (target=_blank with rel=noopener).
